hook: A drug that forces androgen receptor and p300/CBP together shrinks prostate tumors in mice
summary: DALTAC-1 joins two proteins that normally cooperate at the wrong interface, locking them in an inactive state. It blocked androgen-driven gene activity and growth more strongly than inhibiting each protein separately, and spared cells lacking the receptor. Tumor regressions were seen in mouse models only, so human safety and benefit are unknown.
title: Domain-alteration chimeras rewire oncogenic complexes in prostate cancer.
